title: Phi-Renormalization and Global Regularity for Axisymmetric-with-Swirl Navier–Stokes: Algebraic Cancellation of the Axis Singularity, Gronwall-Free Convergence, and the Prime Index Connection
desc: We study the 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations for axisymmetric-with-swirl data.
